statement: The nearest-neighbour Dyson expansion and ell2 unitarity give sum_j|w_j(s)|<=C*sqrt(1+sA|k|)*|u_hat(k)| for each input mode. H3 lattice estimates give F_-1(u_>R)<=C*K/R^2, sum_(k!=0)(1+|k|)^1/2|u_hat(k)|<=C*K, and the corresponding |k|>L tail<=C*K/L. Splitting modes at|p|/2 bounds noncentral low ladders and the entire large-input tail. Consequently F_-1(w(s))<=eps*F_-1(u_<=R)+F_-1(u_>R)+C*K*(1+sA)/N<=3nu/100 uniformly for every H3<=K input. This is an actual uniform tail estimate, not a finite-net or per-initial probability argument.
